sentences.text: The UCB directions say that, for a safe deposit locker or articles in safe custody, the bank shall, within 15 calendar days of receipt of all the required documents, process the claim and communicate with the claimant(s) for fixing the date for making inventory.
The evidence provided does not contain any rule on a locker-related insurance claim settlement period, so that specific timing cannot be answered from the materials supplied.
The closest in-scope rule is the locker / safe custody claim procedure, not an insurance-claim rule.

missing.searched: searched the provided UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions and Commercial Banks Responsible Business Conduct Directions for any locker-related insurance claim settlement timeline; only safe deposit locker / safe custody claim timelines were found.
